question.text: If A and B are non-singular square matrix of same order 3×3, then which of the following options is correct?

options.text: <math><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfenced><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>

<math><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><msup><mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></mfenced></math>

<math><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><msup><mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><msup><mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>

<math><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">j</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><msup><mrow><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>T</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced open="|" close="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>

solution.text:
adj(AB)=AB2
(adj AB)-1=adj AB-1
adj(AB)-1=(AB)-12=AB-2
adj(AB)-1=adj AB-1=AB2-1=AB-2
adj(AB)T=(AB)T2=AB2
